faq.q: What is a Shopify product photo made here?
faq.a: A square page image, a matching collection tile, or a short clip. You start from a photo you upload or a scene you describe.

faq.q: How does a Shopify product photo get made?
faq.a: You upload a picture or describe the scene, pick a style, and download the file. You add it in Shopify admin yourself. We do not publish into the store.

faq.q: Is there a free plan for these Shopify photos?
faq.a: No. There is no free plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A still is 24 credits. Downloads have no watermark.

faq.q: Can I put these photos on my store?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are yours to put on the product page. You still write the name, the price, and the claims. We do not publish into Shopify.

faq.q: What image size works on a product page?
faq.a: Use a square file so the product page and the collection grid match. Check the image size your store is set to use before you upload.

faq.q: Can I refresh a whole collection at once?
faq.a: Yes. Run a batch from the photos you already have, with the same crop and a related backdrop, so older products can sit next to new ones.

faq.q: Can I add a clip on the product page?
faq.a: Yes. Make a clip of 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds and add it in product media yourself. A clip is 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits by length. If a file fails, those credits return on their own.

faq.q: What should the upload look like?
faq.a: Start with a clear, well-lit shot of the whole item. [how to take product photos for AI](/guides/product-photo-tips) walks through a source picture that gives the tool enough to work with.
